title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: Service Contract Tier Ranks
content:
When a documentation charge under `Bills of Lading and Transport Documents` depends on the standing of a service contract, the contract is placed on a numeric ladder. The rank of a contract is the position of its tier in the service contract charter of Aurelia Hanse Line, from the entry tier upwards.

## Rank ladder

| Service contract tier | Tier rank |
|---|---|
| `AHL Starter Service Contract` | 1 |
| `AHL Standard Service Contract` | 2 |
| `AHL Regional Account Contract` | 3 |
| `AHL Key Account Contract` | 4 |
| `AHL Global Account Contract` | 5 |
| `AHL Strategic Partner Contract` | 6 |

## Using the ladder

- The rank belongs to the tier, not to the customer: two contracts of the same tier always have the same rank.
- A higher number denotes a higher tier. A threshold expressed as a rank is reached by a contract whose rank equals it or exceeds it.
- The ladder has six rungs and no others; a tier name that is not listed has no rank on it.

## Hypothetical examples

- A contract on the AHL Key Account Contract tier has rank 4. Measured against a threshold of 5, it falls one rung short; measured against a threshold of 4, it reaches it exactly.
- A contract on the AHL Strategic Partner Contract tier has rank 6, the top of the ladder, and therefore reaches any threshold from 1 to 6.
